history.summary: A generously-sized 646 sqft 1BR at My Manhattan, a D18 (Simei) mixed-development leasehold directly at Simei MRT (110m), asking $999k / $1,546 psf vs a $1,586 median. MRT-on-doorstep, sub-$1M entry, and a reliable 4.6%/yr CAGR make this a solid yield-plus-liquidity buy.
history.rating_rationale: Strong investment profile for a 1BR: 110m to Simei MRT (EWL) and integrated with retail (Eastpoint Mall vicinity / mixed development) gives genuine convenience and tenant pull; 646 sqft is a roomy 1BR (not a tight shoebox), broadening appeal. 81 URA txns support a reliable 4.6%/yr resale CAGR — above the OCR baseline — and the listing PSF is ~2.5% below the project median. Sub-$1M quantum keeps the buyer pool deep. Tampines Regional Centre / CRL+DTL extension catchment nearby supports demand. 99yr from 2014 is the main caveat. Clear Buy on liquidity and yield.
red_flags: 99yr leasehold from 2014 — lease decay over hold
OCR (D18) ceiling — appreciation capped vs central districts
1BR remains a single-tenant format despite the larger size
catalysts: 110m to Simei MRT + integrated retail — strong tenant/owner pull
Reliable 4.6%/yr resale CAGR on 81 txns, listed below project median
Sub-$1M quantum (deep buyer pool); Tampines Regional Centre / CRL catchment

history.summary: My Manhattan (Simei, mixed development directly atop Simei MRT / Eastpoint Mall, TOP 2014) 1BR at $888k / $1,586 psf. The location is genuinely good for 1BR rental, but the unit is NOT cheap — algo shows age_adj +6.3% (slightly above fair) — and resident reviews repeatedly cite structural workmanship issues (rain ingress, mould, peeling paint), a real build-quality concern for a buy-and-hold.
history.rating_rationale: This is the rare cohort name with solid real data: 81 URA transactions, 5yr CAGR 4.55%, and a tight PSF cohort of 8 txns showing the unit at -2.8% vs cohort (essentially at-market). But at-market is not a value edge, and age_adj_premium of +6.3% says it's mildly expensive against age-peers. D18 is favourable OCR, and a 1BR over Simei MRT in a mixed-use block rents well (the investment-friendliest attribute here), but the documented structural/leak complaints are a forward liability for maintenance and resale narrative. With no value discount and a build-quality overhang, it nets to Neutral — the location/rentability and the lack of a discount roughly cancel.
red_flags: Not cheap: age_adj_premium +6.3% (above fair for its age); psf_cohort -2.8% on only 8 txns is at-market, not a bargain
Multiple resident reviews report poor structural workmanship — rain leakage, mould, peeling paint
Trailing 4.55% CAGR has ~0 forward power per v3.4 priors — story only, not a forward guarantee
99-yr leasehold (TOP 2014) — lease decay over the hold
Small 560 sqft 1BR — tenant-dependent income, more cyclical than family units
catalysts: Mixed-use development directly above Simei MRT (EWL) and Eastpoint Mall — strong, durable 1BR tenant demand
~10 min to Changi Airport/Jewel and proximity to Changi Business Park / SUTD employment nodes
Deep real transaction base (81 txns) gives the price discovery more reliability than thin-cohort peers
